source_version: Published version: The Annals of Statistics 52(2), 842–867 (2024)

findings.review_scope: Registered-source content review of the published Annals of Statistics 52(2), 842-867 (2024) paper, DOI 10.1214/24-AOS2371, by Predrag Pilipovic, Adeline Samson and Susanne Ditlevsen. The PDF has 26 pages. The supplementary-material notice on physical page 23 points to separate article and code files; neither was opened. References continue through physical page 26. Fresh text evidence covers all 26 main-paper pages. Theorems, source definitions, assumptions, supporting conventions and boundary pages were inspected visually.
findings.inventory: Exactly five actual Theorem headings occur: 3.3 and 3.5 on page 14, 3.7 on page 15, 5.1 on page 17 and 5.2 on page 18. Theorems 3.3 and 3.5 are restatements of earlier work but remain included because they are labeled Theorem in the main text. Citations, Lemmas, Propositions, Corollaries and separate supplementary results are excluded.
original_statements: Theorem 3.3 retains A1-A2, the exact and approximate processes, both numbered conditions, consistency order q2-1/2, bounded moments, p>=1 and the full 2p-moment-root conclusion with the remainder notation.

Theorems 3.5 and 3.7 preserve their exact LT (10) and Strang (11) references, p>=2, every grid index, existential C>=1 and order-one strong p-moment-root error. A6 occurs only in the Strang theorem. Invariant probability, identifiability and estimator assumptions are not added.

Theorem 5.1 retains all six assumptions, the drift/covariance estimator, minimization of either approximate objective (22) or (23), both sampling limits and both probability limits under the true law. The printed true-covariance shorthand is preserved and explained by page 6.

Theorem 5.2 retains all six assumptions, the covariance-coordinate estimator, the same approximate-objective alternatives, interior true parameter, positive-definite information matrix and all three sampling limits. The normal limit uses sqrt(Nh) for drift and sqrt(N) for covariance coordinates, with inverse C(theta_0) as covariance.
source_passages: All 18 source entries and eight auxiliary passages were checked. The additive-noise SDE (1), complete filtered experiment, decomposition (2), closed parameter search domain, covariance identifiability and true-parameter shorthand match pages 1 and 6. The six numbered assumptions retain their separate statements and types: one-sided Lipschitz/C2 regularity, polynomial increments and derivatives, invariant probability, covariance invertibility, drift identifiability and asymptotic inverse-flow availability.

The equidistant grid, exact OU flow and matrix-exponential covariance, nonlinear forward flow and semigroup properties match pages 7-8. Both components of Definition 2.3 retain the precise composition order and Gaussian innovation location. Forward-flow existence is kept separate from the inverse-flow assumption.

Definitions 3.1 and 3.2 on page 13 preserve the conditional mean and 2p-moment consistency bounds, q1>=q2+1/2 and the bounded-moment quantifiers. The generic remainder definition, derivative orientation, stochastic convergence notation and fixed-horizon limitations remain separate supporting conventions.

Both approximate objective formulas (22)/(23) match page 17, including the negative quadratic correction and positive trace-Jacobian contribution for Strang. The transformed residual (13) matches page 9, with the inverse half-flow at the current observation. Full objectives (12)/(14), minimizers (15) and the source inverse-Jacobian identity are archived separately as context.

Covariance half-vectorization across pages 17-18 preserves the printed ordering, general dimension and diagonal alternative. The limiting block information matrix (27) retains the invariant-law integral, covariance derivatives, half trace, index bounds and nearby Fisher-information naming context.
findings.dependency_review: All 39 direct uses, all 18 reach sets and all 50 related connections were checked. The model, parameter decomposition, A1-A2 and observation grid reach all five theorems. Invariant probability, covariance invertibility, identifiability and approximate objectives reach only the two estimation theorems. OU and forward flows reach both splitting theorems and both estimation theorems. A6 reaches the Strang theorem and the two estimation theorems. The specific LT/Strang schemes each reach their named convergence theorem. Local consistency and bounded moments reach only the generic convergence theorem. Covariance coordinates and information reach only asymptotic normality. Proof-only bounds, Lorenz examples and competing estimators are not inserted as prerequisites.
findings.names_and_highlights: Every source entry has readable source-derived keywords, preserved source headings and selectors checked against its own passage or related same-paper theorem. A1-A6 remain assumptions, the experiment/domain/grid remain source passages, and numbered definitions retain their source identities. The pair of approximate contrasts is preserved as the author presents it, without a synthesized replacement formula.
findings.source_limitations: All 19 existing notes were checked. They distinguish full and approximate objectives; closed versus open parameter domains; noise-square-root versus covariance coordinates; true-covariance and derivative shorthand; pointwise/asymptotic versus uniform inverse availability; proof-only inverse growth; the printed inverse-Jacobian argument issue; the weak remainder in covariance expansion (6); the domain of generic remainder notation; driving-noise coupling for strong errors; fixed versus diverging horizons; moment orders and constants; missing explicit smoothness for linear drift parameters; invariant-measure versus ergodicity requirements; elliptic versus proposed hypoelliptic extensions; covariance-vector ordering and diagonal dimension; Jacobian orientation; unresolved minimizer selection/existence; and inclusion of restated Theorems. Source fidelity does not certify proofs or repair the paper.
findings.changes: No census-content correction was required. All six saved JSON artifacts and the original audit remain unchanged. Earlier scripts are archived, and the saved per-paper rebuild now resolves the verified fixed local PDF without depending on the old temporary PDF path.
findings.validation: Independent inventory and census validators pass, and all six regenerated artifacts match saved bytes. Source identity, exact theorem-heading enumeration, main-paper endpoint, all direct and recursive edge sets, all reach sets and paths, selector occurrences and audit artifact hashes supplement the completed manual source review.
